title: Axeyum Lean reconstruction prelude axiom ledger

trust_policy.publication_rule: The integer prelude admits no assumption; a checked dependency closure using it inherits nothing from this ledger.

classification_definitions.unclassified: No semantic classification has been accepted yet.
classification_definitions.primitive-interface: A carrier or operation intentionally remains an abstract interface constant.
classification_definitions.external-assumption: A proposition intentionally remains a named assumption of the profile.
classification_definitions.derivable-theorem: The declaration should be replaced by a checked theorem term.
classification_definitions.defect: The declaration is false, malformed in intent, redundant unsafely, or otherwise must not remain trusted.

discharge_definitions.unreviewed: No row-specific discharge decision has been accepted.
discharge_definitions.retained: The assumption is intentionally retained with a published boundary.
discharge_definitions.planned: A concrete theorem/import route is assigned but not implemented.
discharge_definitions.in-progress: The assigned discharge implementation is active.
discharge_definitions.discharged: A retained checked theorem artifact replaces assumption credit.
discharge_definitions.rejected: The declaration is removed or prohibited from the supported profile.

entries.name: Real
entries.canonical_type: Sort (1)
entries.note: Carrier sort of the real reconstruction profile; intentionally abstract.

entries.name: Real.add
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> Real))
entries.note: Binary operation of the ring interface; intentionally abstract.

entries.name: Real.add_assoc
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.add (Real.add x0 x1) x2) (Real.add x0 (Real.add x1 x2)))))
entries.note: Associativity of `add`: an abelian-group axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.add_comm
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.add x0 x1) (Real.add x1 x0)))
entries.note: Commutativity of `add`: an abelian-group axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.add_le_add
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> ((x3 : Real) -> ((x4 : Real.le x0 x1) -> ((x5 : Real.le x2 x3) -> Real.le (Real.add x0 x2) (Real.add x1 x3)))))))
entries.note: Additive monotonicity of `le`. Stated in the four-argument form; not derivable from the one-sided form, which this profile does not admit.

entries.name: Real.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> ((x3 : Real) -> ((x4 : Real.le x0 x1) -> ((x5 : Real.lt x2 x3) -> Real.lt (Real.add x0 x2) (Real.add x1 x3)))))))
entries.note: Mixed additive monotonicity; an ordered-ring compatibility assumption connecting `add`, `le`, and `lt`.

entries.name: Real.add_neg
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.add x0 (Real.neg x0)) Real.zero)
entries.note: Right inverse for `add`: an abelian-group axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.add_zero
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.add x0 Real.zero) x0)
entries.note: Right identity for `add`: an abelian-group axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.le
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> Prop))
entries.note: Order relation of the profile, declared as a primitive `Prop`-valued relation.

entries.name: Real.le_of_lt
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real.lt x0 x1) -> Real.le x0 x1)))
entries.note: Connects the two primitive order relations (`lt` implies `le`). Not derivable because `lt` is a primitive, not a definition; load-bearing — `lt_trans` is derived from it.

entries.name: Real.le_refl
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Real.le x0 x0)
entries.note: Reflexivity of `le`: a preorder axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.le_trans
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> ((x3 : Real.le x0 x1) -> ((x4 : Real.le x1 x2) -> Real.le x0 x2)))))
entries.note: Transitivity of `le`: a preorder axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.left_distrib
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.mul x0 (Real.add x1 x2)) (Real.add (Real.mul x0 x1) (Real.mul x0 x2)))))
entries.note: Left distributivity: the commutative-ring axiom linking `add` and `mul`. Load-bearing — `mul_zero` is derived from it.

entries.name: Real.lt
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> Prop))
entries.note: Strict order relation, declared as a primitive `Prop`-valued relation independent of `le`; the two are connected only by the order-interface assumptions below.

entries.name: Real.lt_irrefl
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Not (Real.lt x0 x0))
entries.note: Irreflexivity of the primitive `lt`; independent of the `le` axioms.

entries.name: Real.lt_of_le_of_lt
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> ((x3 : Real.le x0 x1) -> ((x4 : Real.lt x1 x2) -> Real.lt x0 x2)))))
entries.note: Mixed transitivity of the two primitive order relations; an order-interface assumption.

entries.name: Real.lt_of_lt_of_le
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> ((x3 : Real.lt x0 x1) -> ((x4 : Real.le x1 x2) -> Real.lt x0 x2)))))
entries.note: Mixed transitivity of the two primitive order relations; load-bearing — `lt_trans` is derived from it.

entries.name: Real.lt_trans
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> ((x3 : Real.lt x0 x1) -> ((x4 : Real.lt x1 x2) -> Real.lt x0 x2)))))
entries.note: Derivable from the order interface: `le_of_lt` turns `lt y z` into `le y z`, and `lt_of_lt_of_le` combines it with `lt x y` to give `lt x z`. Route: replace with a checked theorem term over `le_of_lt` and `lt_of_lt_of_le`.

entries.name: Real.mul
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> Real))
entries.note: Binary operation of the ring interface; intentionally abstract.

entries.name: Real.mul_assoc
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.mul (Real.mul x0 x1) x2) (Real.mul x0 (Real.mul x1 x2)))))
entries.note: Associativity of `mul`: a commutative-ring axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.mul_comm
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.mul x0 x1) (Real.mul x1 x0)))
entries.note: Commutativity of `mul`: a commutative-ring axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real) -> ((x3 : Real.le Real.zero x0) -> ((x4 : Real.le x1 x2) -> Real.le (Real.mul x0 x1) (Real.mul x0 x2))))))
entries.note: Multiplicative monotonicity under a nonnegative left factor: the ordered-ring axiom for `mul`. Load-bearing — `mul_nonneg` is derived from it.

entries.name: Real.mul_nonneg
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> ((x1 : Real) -> ((x2 : Real.le Real.zero x0) -> ((x3 : Real.le Real.zero x1) -> Real.le Real.zero (Real.mul x0 x1)))))
entries.note: Derivable from `mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left` instantiated at `x1 := zero`, `x2 := b`: from `0 <= a` and `0 <= b` it yields `a*0 <= a*b`, and `mul_zero` rewrites `a*0` to `0`. Route: replace with a checked theorem term over `mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left` and `mul_zero` (itself derivable).

entries.name: Real.mul_one
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.mul x0 Real.one) x0)
entries.note: Right identity for `mul`: a commutative-ring axiom of the profile.

entries.name: Real.mul_zero
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Eq.{1} Real (Real.mul x0 Real.zero) Real.zero)
entries.note: Derivable in any ring: `left_distrib` gives `x*(0+0) = x*0 + x*0`, `add_zero` rewrites the left side to `x*0`, and cancelling with `add_neg`/`add_assoc`/`add_comm` yields `x*0 = 0`. Route: replace with a checked theorem term over `left_distrib`, `add_zero`, `add_assoc`, `add_comm`, `add_neg`.

entries.name: Real.neg
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Real)
entries.note: Additive inverse operation of the ring interface; intentionally abstract.

entries.name: Real.one
entries.canonical_type: Real
entries.note: Multiplicative identity constant of the ring interface; intentionally abstract.

entries.name: Real.sq_nonneg
entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Real) -> Real.le Real.zero (Real.mul x0 x0))
entries.note: Squares are nonnegative. NOT derivable in this profile: the standard proof case-splits on `le_total`, which the real prelude deliberately does not admit. It is therefore a genuine assumption here, and the reason the real profile is a partially ordered ring rather than a linearly ordered one. Consumed by the SOS/NRA certificate route.

entries.name: Real.zero
entries.canonical_type: Real
entries.note: Additive identity constant of the ring interface; intentionally abstract.

entries.name: Real.zero_lt_one
entries.canonical_type: Real.lt Real.zero Real.one
entries.note: Nontriviality of the profile; excludes the zero ring.

entries.name: axeyum.string.2.append

entries.note: Binary carrier operation of the string reconstruction profile; intentionally abstract. Note this row is inserted directly as `Declaration::Axiom` rather than through `declare_axiom(...)`, which is why the earlier 64-row call-site census missed it.

retired_entries.name: Int.eq_em
retired_entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Int) -> ((x1 : Int) -> Or (Eq.{1} Int x0 x1) (Not (Eq.{1} Int x0 x1))))
retired_entries.note: Decidable equality on `Z` stated as excluded middle for `x = y`. This is a direct instance of `Classical.em` applied to the proposition `Eq Z x y`, and `Classical.em` is already declared on demand by `crates/axeyum-solver/src/reconstruct.rs` as the single genuine logical axiom of the reconstruction route. Discharging this row removes a *theory-specific* assumption in favour of the already-accepted logical one, strictly shrinking the integer profile's trusted base. Route: replace with a checked theorem term instantiating `Classical.em`.
retired_entries.retirement_note: Left the trusted surface when the integer development was proved out: the carrier became an inductive over the proved Nat development, the operations became checked definitions, and the laws became theorems with empty axiom footprints.

retired_entries.name: Int.euclidean_decomposition
retired_entries.canonical_type: ((x0 : Int) -> ((x1 : Int) -> ((x2 : Int.lt Int.zero x1) -> Exists.{1} Int (fun (x3 : Int) => Exists.{1} Int (fun (x4 : Int) => And (Eq.{1} Int x0 (Int.add (Int.mul x1 x3) x4)) (And (Int.le Int.zero x4) (Int.lt x4 x1)))))))
retired_entries.note: Division with remainder. Derivable only from well-ordering or an induction principle, neither of which this profile admits over the opaque carrier `Z`; retained as a named assumption of the Diophantine/LIA route.
retired_entries.retirement_note: Discharged: Int.euclidean_decomposition became a theorem over the proved Nat development, leaving the integer prelude with no assumption at all. Its witnesses are uniform per sign case — q = negSucc a and r = ofNat (K - succ b) on the negative branch — so no case needed a new axiom.
